name: Tuner T1
summary: Tuner T1 brings a chromatic instrument tuner to a resizable 2D window. Use the pitch display and reference keyboard, or choose instrument reference notes for guitar, ukulele, violin and more. Adjust reference pitch and tuning settings to suit your practice. Microphone permission is used for live pitch analysis on the device. Reference tones remain available when microphone access is denied. One purchase includes the Horizon edition's features without advertising or in-app purchases.
